name: Closing lift
look: The last section uncovers the closing photograph. The photograph settles from a close crop, the line stays at full opacity and only the action fades.
reduced: A plain closing section with the photograph, the line and the action.
phone: The closing photograph follows in ordinary flow. Its line stands at full opacity and its action fades in.

needs.words: a closing line of 3 to 7 words, one line and one action; the closing section of its own, the footer after it
needs.picture: A calm dark lower third under light text, or a solid reading band.
